text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival.
An event where Umamusume welcome the fans who support them day in and day out, hosting various attractions and games.

Seeking the Pearl participated as manager
in this year's main event: the All-Star Sandlot Baseball Tournament—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Aah... bases loaded on a walk, huh. We're still in the lead, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The score is... 6-3, isn't it~
A home run would turn it into a walk-off loss~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What do we do, Director?
If we're gonna make a move, isn't now the time?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
The cleanup hitter is up next, right?! Wow, it's just like a manga!
Let's go, let's go! Hit a walk-off home ruuun♪

Bottom of the 9th, the team in a huge pinch.
At that moment, Seeking the Pearl... made her move—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! Umpire!
Time for a pitching change!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The pitcher is... me!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm everyone's manager!
When the team's in a pinch, I have to step up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant by moving your body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It might be fine according to the rules, but...
your shoulder isn't warmed up yet, is it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, leave it to me. The hasty Goddess of Victory is already giving me a wink!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you have the Goddesses' stamp of approval.
In that case, we leave it to you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Pearl-san, please.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Pearl-san is taking the mound!?
No way! It's anyone's game right down to the wire now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Unfortunate for you, but El is up next to bat.
I'd appreciate it if you didn't forget
my 3-for-3 home run record today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll launch the game-ending fireworks with my signature Quebradora con Giro swing, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, for Seeking the Pearl,
here comes the much-anticipated first pitch...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Think you can hit my excellent ball—
CAN YOUUU!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Buenooo graaaciaaaas!!
(*CRRAAAACK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A huge hit, soaring like a condor!
It might reach all the way to the stands!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay! It's settled, yeesss!!
Just like this, a home ru—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's not over yet!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl throws away her glove
and makes a mad daaaash toward the stands!!

text_block_list.name: Teammates & Fans
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Reaching near the stands!
Wait, at this angle, is it a home run!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pearrrrrl!
Go for itttt! Flyyyyyy~~~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh... "Move to America"?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. I am Seeking the Pearl,
soaring out into the world.
A world-class talent ready to spread her wings to America, too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can even reach a home run ball!
Now is the time to spread my wings! Hah!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geh?! Using the stands as a springboard!
Is that even allowed, desuuu--?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Reach themmm!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah!? Pearl-san!
We're in the spectator seats!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Seeking the Pearl and the ball have
gone into the stands together!
A walk-off grand slam to end the game!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No! I flew in the wrong direction...!
I lost my sense of direction defying gravity.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That's way too grand of a scale!
Though that's so like you, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun today!
I'll keep cheering for you!

Though they lost the match, Seeking the Pearl's
play remained etched in everyone's memories!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Catch!
And now... right back at youuuu--!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What a throw, flying straight like a bottle rocket—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The runner can't make it back, he's OUT!
And that brings a decisive end to the game!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've won~.
Lady Pearl's jump truly exceeded all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's seriously insane... Hehe, we did it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't everyone say it?
The Goddess of Victory is winking at us♪"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaaa, I've got crazy goosebumps!
I'm so, so glad I came to watch this liveeee!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pearrrrrl!
That was faaaantastic~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can fly anywhere I want!
Ohohohoho!!

Seeking the Pearl instantly became a hero.
They say this dramatic victory
would be passed down at Tracen Academy for years to come...
